messages:
Eve (design): Quick sync: proposal to make compact action buttons 32px visually to line up with our condensed table rows. Keep 44px hit area via invisible padding. Also, toast stacking is covering inline row actions on narrow screens  propose to render toasts above the toolbar but beneath modal overlays, non-interactive by default. Thoughts? :eyes:

Tom (frontend): Visual +1. Invisible padding is fine. Will implement with a ::after that expands the hit area so we don't change layout. Concern: z-index proliferation. Can we standardize z vars?

Lina (a11y): Accessibility checklist: visible button size can be 32px, but touch target must be >=44px. Using a pseudo-element is acceptable as long as keyboard focus ring still appears on the element itself. Toasts should use role="status" and aria-live="polite" and must not grab focus. Non-interactive toasts must be removed from tab order.

Omar (devexp): Agreed on z vars: --z-toolbar:700, --z-toast:800, --z-modal-overlay:1000. Toasts default pointer-events:none; interactive variant pointer-events:auto + tabindex=0. Also, if we rename compact spacing tokens, add one-release aliases to prevent downstream breakage.

Tom (frontend): I'll add token aliases in tokens.json and include a small visual regression test for compact table + actions. Snippet for hit area: `.btn-compact { position: relative; height:32px } .btn-compact::after{ content:''; position:absolute; left:0; right:0; top:-6px; bottom:-6px; }`

Eve (design): Nice. Small copy nit: change console empty-state CTA from "Try again" to "Retry" for consistency. Also, interactive toasts need a close affordance that is keyboard reachable.

Lina (a11y): Confirming keyboard flow: Escape should still close modals even when a toast appears above toolbar. Interactive toasts must receive focus only when explicitly opened and should return focus to the triggering element when dismissed. I'll run VoiceOver checks on staging.

Omar (devexp): I'll open a draft PR with token aliases, z vars, compact-btn patch, and a tiny visual test. We can canary it in staging and require one design + one a11y review before merge.

Tom (frontend): Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/1301 (WIP)  includes aliases and z var changes.

bot-deploy: CI queued for branch/compact-density-fix. Tests: visual-regress, a11y-check
